topics.topic_name: Banking Operations and Central Bank Role

questions.question: Which institution serves as the central bank of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh Bank is the supreme regulatory authority and central monetary authority of Bangladesh.

questions.question: Which function is the exclusive monopoly privilege of a central bank?
questions.explanation: Only the central bank has the legal authority to issue standard paper currency notes.

questions.question: The primary source of profit for commercial banks is:

options.label: A
options.text: Spread between lending rate and deposit interest rate

questions.correct_answer_text: Spread between lending rate and deposit interest rate
questions.explanation: Commercial banks borrow from depositors at lower rates and lend to borrowers at higher rates, earning the interest margin spread.

questions.question: Why is the Central Bank referred to as the 'Lender of Last Resort'?

options.label: A
options.text: It provides loans to ordinary students

options.label: B
options.text: It assists commercial banks during severe liquidity crises when no other source is available

options.label: C
options.text: It charges the lowest interest in the country

options.label: D
options.text: It only lends to foreign nations

questions.correct_answer_text: It assists commercial banks during severe liquidity crises when no other source is available
questions.explanation: When commercial banks exhaust all borrowing avenues, the central bank bails them out with emergency liquidity.

questions.question: What is CRR in central bank monetary policy?
questions.explanation: CRR represents the portion of total bank deposits that commercial banks must maintain in liquid cash reserves with the central bank.
